verdict.rationale: Claude Agent SDK is extensively documented as a public API (Python and TypeScript packages, query() calls, configuration options, hooks, custom tools, MCP, sessions, streaming) with pip/npm install and GitHub repo confirming programmatic usage, giving AI-native developers a documented way to drive it.
